_about: Minor Pythagorean texts in Thomas Taylor's translation, clean Gutenberg: Ocellus Lucanus on the Nature of the Universe, with Taurus, Julius Firmicus Maternus and Proclus pieces (1831). Also Taylor's Sallust on the Gods and the World with the Pythagoric Sentences of Demophilus (Jeffery, 1793), raw IA OCR; the title page names no translator.
